title: The Messengership Of Prophet Muhammad 16th Degree 4th Proof The Consensus Of The Prophets

questions.question: According to the passage, whose agreement is presented as a powerful proof for Allah’s existence and oneness?
questions.answer: The agreement of the prophets is presented as a strong proof.

questions.question: Besides pointing to Allah’s oneness, what else does that agreement of the prophets support about this being?
questions.answer: It supports that he was truthful and truly sent as a messenger.

questions.question: What kind of qualities found in earlier prophets were also present in him in a complete way?
questions.answer: The holy qualities, miracles, and duties that show real prophethood were all found in him fully.

questions.question: In which earlier revealed books did prophets give good news about his coming?
questions.answer: In the Torah, the Gospels, the Psalms, and other revealed pages.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the way the prophets supported his mission through their actions?
questions.answer: Their deeds and miracles confirmed his mission, like placing their signatures on it.

questions.question: What two things do the prophets show by their united words and their united deeds?
questions.answer: By their words they point to Allah’s oneness, and by their deeds they testify to his truthfulness.

questions.question: Who are the people mentioned in the next section who reached truth and spiritual excellence by following him?
questions.answer: They are the saints.

questions.question: What do these saints bear witness to besides Allah’s oneness?
questions.answer: They also bear witness to his truthfulness and messengerhood.

questions.question: How did these saints come to know some of the unseen truths he taught?
questions.answer: They came to know them through the light of sainthood.

questions.question: How did they accept the rest of the truths he brought?
questions.answer: They believed in and confirmed all of them through the light of faith, with different levels of certainty.

questions.question: What do the saints’ testimony and certainty show about him?
questions.answer: They show clearly that he was completely truthful and upright.

questions.question: What did the traveler understand from both the prophets and the saints?
questions.answer: He understood that both groups gave strong evidence that this being was a true messenger.

questions.question: Why does the passage connect earlier prophets to this being’s message?
questions.answer: Because the signs of true prophethood seen in them were also present in him, and they also foretold his coming.

questions.question: What does history testify about him in relation to the prophets?
questions.answer: History shows that the signs of truthful prophethood were fully present in him.

questions.question: What is the purpose of mentioning many examples from earlier scriptures?
questions.answer: It is to show that his coming had been announced before and was not something unexpected.

questions.question: When the passage says prophets “signed” his mission, what does that mean?
questions.answer: It means their miracles and prophetic works supported and confirmed his mission.

questions.question: According to the passage, how is his mission described compared with other prophetic missions?
questions.answer: It is described as the highest and most complete in carrying out the work of prophethood.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the section called “The Fifth”?
questions.answer: It explains that saints who followed him also prove his truthfulness and messengerhood.

questions.question: What kinds of spiritual blessings did these saints reach through following him?
questions.answer: They reached truth, reality, perfection, amazing spiritual gifts, and inner witnessing.

questions.question: What are the three levels of certainty mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: Certainty through knowledge, certainty through direct seeing, and complete certainty.

questions.question: Why is the saints’ witness especially strong in this passage?
questions.answer: Because they personally experienced some of the truths he taught and fully believed the rest with firm certainty.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the clarity of this proof?
questions.answer: It says the proof is as clear and bright as the sun.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does the agreement of all prophets prove about Allah?
questions.answer: It proves Allah’s existence and His oneness.

questions.question: What does that same agreement prove about this being?
questions.answer: It proves that he was truthful and truly a messenger.

questions.question: What three signs of true prophethood are said to be fully found in him?
questions.answer: Sacred qualities, miracles, and prophetic duties.

questions.question: How do the earlier revealed scriptures relate to him?
questions.answer: They contain announcements and glad tidings about his coming.

questions.question: Does the passage present the prophets’ support for him as only words, or as words and actions together?
questions.answer: It presents it as both words and actions together.

questions.question: What is one way the prophets supported him through actions rather than only speech?
questions.answer: Their miracles and prophetic works confirmed his mission.

questions.question: Who are the people in “The Fifth” that followed his teaching and reached high spiritual ranks?
questions.answer: They are the saints.

questions.question: What two major beliefs do these saints agree on according to the passage?
questions.answer: They agree on Allah’s oneness and on his truthfulness and messengerhood.

questions.question: What part of his message did they witness through spiritual light?
questions.answer: They witnessed some of the unseen truths he had proclaimed.

questions.question: What part of his message did they affirm by faith?
questions.answer: They affirmed all of the truths he brought.

questions.question: How did all this affect the traveler’s understanding?
questions.answer: It helped him see that the evidence for this being’s truthfulness was very strong and united.

questions.question: What comparison is made at the start of “The Fourth”?
questions.answer: It compares the prophets’ agreement about Allah’s oneness with their agreement about this being’s truthfulness and mission.

questions.question: What does the passage say history confirms about him?
questions.answer: History confirms that the marks of true prophethood were fully present in him.

questions.question: Which sources are named as containing earlier news about his coming?
questions.answer: The Torah, the Gospels, the Psalms, and other revealed writings.

questions.question: What does the phrase about putting a signature on his mission teach us in simple words?
questions.answer: It teaches that the prophets strongly approved and confirmed his mission.

questions.question: What makes his mission stand out among prophetic missions in this passage?
questions.answer: It is described as the leading and most complete example of prophetic work.

questions.question: In “The Fifth,” who gives another united testimony after the prophets?
questions.answer: The saints give another united testimony.

questions.question: What did these saints gain by learning from him and following him?
questions.answer: They gained spiritual truth, deep reality, maturity, and special inner insight.

questions.question: How do the saints support his message concerning the unseen world?
questions.answer: They saw some of those truths through spiritual experience and accepted all of them with certainty.

questions.question: What quality of this being is emphasized at the end of “The Fifth”?
questions.answer: His complete truthfulness and straightness are emphasized.

questions.question: What overall lesson do both sections teach together?
questions.answer: They teach that both earlier prophets and later saints give united proof that he was a true messenger.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is one result of the prophets all agreeing with one another?
questions.answer: Their agreement becomes strong evidence.

questions.question: Evidence for which two things about Allah and this being is discussed in “The Fourth”?
questions.answer: It is evidence for Allah’s existence and oneness, and for this being’s truthfulness and messengerhood.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the signs that show a prophet is genuine?
questions.answer: It says those signs were present in him in a full way.

questions.question: How did earlier prophets prepare people for his coming?
questions.answer: They spoke of his coming beforehand and gave glad tidings about him.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention both speech and deeds of the prophets?
questions.answer: To show that they supported him in more than one way.

questions.question: What is the meaning of the prophets being united in their deeds?
questions.answer: It means their prophetic works and miracles matched in supporting his truthfulness.

questions.question: Who are the witnesses named in “The Fifth,” and what path led them to their station?
questions.answer: They are saints, and they reached their station by learning from him and following him.

questions.question: What kinds of spiritual experience are mentioned for these saints?
questions.answer: Their experiences include discovering truth, reaching perfection, receiving wondrous acts, unveiling, and witnessing.

questions.question: What did they testify about Allah?
questions.answer: They testified to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What did they testify about this being?
questions.answer: They testified that he was truthful and was truly Allah’s messenger.

questions.question: How were the saints able to confirm some unseen matters he taught?
questions.answer: They confirmed some of them through spiritual light and direct inner witnessing.

questions.question: What image does the passage use to show how clear their testimony is?
questions.answer: It uses the brightness of the sun to show how clear it is.

questions.question: What two sections are included in the target passage?
questions.answer: The sections called “The Fourth” and “The Fifth.”

questions.question: In “The Fourth,” what group is used as the first witness for this being’s truthfulness?
questions.answer: The prophets are used as the first witness.

questions.question: What makes their witness especially strong according to the passage?
questions.answer: Their witness is strong because they were united, and the signs of prophethood were fully found in him too.

questions.question: Name the revealed books mentioned as carrying earlier news of him.
questions.answer: The Torah, the Gospels, the Psalms, and other revealed pages.

questions.question: What does the passage say the prophets’ miracles and actions did for his mission?
questions.answer: They confirmed it and supported it strongly.

questions.question: What do the prophets’ united words show, and what do their united deeds show?
questions.answer: Their words show Allah’s oneness, and their deeds show his truthfulness.

questions.question: In “The Fifth,” what second group is presented as witnesses?
questions.answer: The saints are presented as witnesses.

questions.question: What had these saints achieved through his training and example?
questions.answer: They had reached spiritual truth, inner reality, excellence, extraordinary acts, and deep witnessing.

questions.question: What is the connection between these saints and the unseen truths he taught?
questions.answer: They experienced some of those truths through sainthood and believed all of them with certainty.

questions.question: What are the three forms of certainty named in the passage?
questions.answer: Certainty based on knowledge, certainty based on direct seeing, and complete certainty.

questions.question: What does the saints’ agreement show about their view of him?
questions.answer: It shows that they saw him as completely truthful and straight.

questions.question: If both prophets before him and saints after him support him, what conclusion does the passage lead the reader to?
questions.answer: It leads the reader to conclude that his messengerhood and truthfulness are firmly proven.
